messages:
jordan: Following up on the postmortem: we split remediation into three discreet owners (timeouts, partial/resume, reconnect jitter). Need short ETAs and a checklist for canary verification. Can everyone ack and drop estimates?

lee: Ill take timeouts. Plan: RCA + instrumentation PR by EOW, canary toggle next Wed. Will add strict timeout traces to the streaming path.

monica: Ill own partial/resume behavior. Hypothesis: buffer flush race when client reconnects + server GC. Will run targeted load tests and attach logs. ETA 5 business days.

kevin: Reconnect/backoff + SDK changes are on me. Will push RFC with client examples by Tue and a compat test harness by Fri.

eng-obs-bot: Trace set requested: https://internal/traces/stream-193002 - scrubbed. Also flagged 12 spans with high tail latency.

jordan: Good. Also need someone to lock SLOs/alerts to detect recurrence within 24h. Who can draft alert spec?

lee: I can draft a minimal alert (5xx+stream-aborts >0.5% over 10m OR partial-response-rate >0.2%). Will send in #eng-alerts for review.

monica: For verification, I'll provide a small reproducer and a post-fix runbook step list.

kevin: SDK will include jitter and a non-blocking reconnect mode. Example snippet I'll include in RFC: `reconnect: { baseMs: 250, maxMs: 4000, jitter: 'full', attempts: 5 }`.

jordan: Summarizing action items (please confirm):
- Timeouts instrumentation + RCA: lee - by 1930100000.
- Partial/resume repro + fix plan: monica - by 1930120000.
- SDK reconnect RFC + compat tests: kevin - RFC by 1930050000, tests by 1930130000.
- Alert spec + dashboard: lee -> handoff to infra after review - spec by 1930060000.
- Weekly follow-up: recurring Fri 9am PT, first check 1930080000.

Please ack and update if dates conflict.

lee: Ack.

monica: Ack, small conflict on the final date but will update Jira.

kevin: Ack. Will tag SDK maintainers in RFC.

ops-bot: Jira issues created: STREAM-7107, STREAM-7108, STREAM-7109.

jordan: Thanks folks. If anyone hits a blocker, escalate here and ping @jordan. Reopening thread for any mid-week updates.

kevin: Quick note on canary policy: prefer 8-12% of streaming pods with enhanced logging. Example canary config: ```
streaming.canary:
  enabled: true
  percent: 10
  timeout_override_ms: 15000
  strict_logging: true
```

monica: I'll attach the reproducer and test results to the Jira ticket by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: Closing initial sync. Will post calendar invite and Jira links shortly. :white_check_mark:
